label: Proxmox VE virtualization connector
summary: Prepare selected Proxmox VE pool, node, image and guest references for authorized VPS/VM workflows.
core_boundary: A tenant guest is distinct from its hypervisor. Basic Core hosting controls remain free and a plugin never gains unrestricted hypervisor administrator authority. This is a design-only connector proposal. Essential hosting, current actor and tenant authorization, native service drivers and recovery remain in the free Core. No production interface, publisher trust, installation or effectful capability is established by this metadata.
acceptance: Qualify a selected Proxmox VE API profile with admitted cluster, pool, node, guest and storage ownership plus narrowly scoped credentials.
Separate guest power/snapshot/clone proposals from host maintenance, migration and network changes; require explicit higher authority for hypervisor-wide effects.
Exercise asynchronous tasks, uncertain create completion, guest quotas and snapshot recovery; retain guest disks by default and distinguish deletion from authorized storage purge.

Before implementation, qualify an explicitly selected provider/interface revision, supported compatibility matrix, immutable package provenance, dependency inventory and licensing model; no release is admitted by this proposal.

Enforce current Core actor, tenant and capability checks at each admitted request; keep credentials in scoped secret references, redact diagnostics and reject arbitrary destinations, shell commands or host/container sockets.

Demonstrate that disablement, removal, provider outage and commercial entitlement loss preserve essential Core access, hosted workloads, local audit and recovery; retain owned data unless a separately authorized purge is requested.
